# construct test from listed coordinates
h,w=20,19
g=[[9]*w for _ in range(h)]
pts=[(0,9),(1,14),(3,10),(5,16),(7,3),(8,8),(9,2),(11,3),(12,11),(13,2),(13,16),(15,3),(15,12),(18,8)]
for r,c in pts:g[r][c]=6
g[19]=[9]*19
g[19][12:17]=[8,0,0,3,0]
out=[row[:] for row in g]
pat=[8,0,0,3,0]
for r,c in pts:
 for j,v in enumerate(pat):
  cc=c-2+j
  if 0<=cc<w: out[r][cc]=v
# save program
import pathlib
prog='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    # The motif is the five-cell object on the final row; copy it at each marker.\n    motif = grid[-1][12:17]\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid[:-1]):\n        for c, value in enumerate(row):\n            if value == 6:\n                for j, v in enumerate(motif):\n                    cc = c - 2 + j\n                    if 0 <= cc < w:\n                        out[r][cc] = v\n    return out\n'''
